# @matz/ui (v0.1.0-beta.1) — AI-First Design System, UI Library & Wails Native Bridge

> Official LLM & AI Coding Agent Reference (`llms.txt`).
> Primary Stack: HTML5 + Native CSS3 + Vanilla TypeScript (Zero Runtime Dependencies).
> Official Adapters: Go + Wails v2/v3 (`@matz/ui/wails`), React 19 / Next.js 15, Vue 3, Svelte 5, Tailwind CSS, SCSS.

## 1. Quick Installation & Setup

```bash
# CLI Initializer (Vanilla TS, Wails, React, Vue, Svelte)
npx @matz/ui@beta init

# Package Managers
npm install @matz/ui@beta
pnpm add @matz/ui@beta
bun add @matz/ui@beta
```

```ts
import '@matz/ui/styles.css';
import { enableMatzSpotlight } from '@matz/ui';

// Root HTML attributes control Dual-Theme, Product Palette, and Ergonomic Density:
// <html lang="pt-BR" data-theme="dark" data-product="matz" data-density="default">
enableMatzSpotlight();
```

## 2. Core Design Tokens (CSS Custom Properties)

Always use semantic tokens instead of hardcoded colors so Dark (`Specular Obsidian`) and Light (`Architectural Alabaster`) themes work automatically with WCAG 2.1 AAA contrast:

- `--surface-canvas`: Main app background (`#080a10` dark / `#f8fafc` light)
- `--surface-card-solid`: Elevated card surface (`#0f131d` dark / `#ffffff` light)
- `--surface-elevated`: Secondary interactive surface (`#141926` dark / `#f1f5f9` light)
- `--surface-input`: Unified background for `<input>`, `<textarea>`, `<select>` (`#0a0d15` dark / `#ffffff` light)
- `--text-primary`: Primary text (`#f8fafc` dark / `#0f172a` light)
- `--text-secondary`: Muted/descriptive text (`#94a3b8` dark / `#475569` light)
- `--accent`: Active brand accent (`#8b5cf6` default; changes with `data-product="matz|heapi|myterm|bycode|writtt"`)
- `--border`: Specular 1px border token

## 3. CSS Primitive Classes

- Containers & Surfaces: `.matz-card`, `.matz-card.matz-beam-top` (1px top specular highlight)
- Buttons: `.matz-btn`, `.matz-btn-primary`, `.matz-btn-sm`, `.matz-btn-lg`
- Form Controls (Zero White-Leak): `.matz-input`, `.matz-textarea`, `.matz-select`, `.matz-switch`
- Navigation & Grouping: `.matz-segmented`, `.matz-segmented-btn.active`, `.matz-collapsible-section`
- Feedback & Badges: `.matz-badge`, `.matz-badge-cyan`, `.matz-badge-emerald`, `.matz-badge-amber`, `.matz-badge-rose`, `.matz-kbd`
- Data Tables & Code: `.matz-table-wrap`, `.matz-table`, `.matz-code-block`, `.matz-tabular`

## 4. Deterministic TypeScript Component APIs (`@matz/ui`)

All interactive components mount into a standard `HTMLElement` with a single deterministic function call:

```ts
import {
  matzIcon,
  showMatzToast,
  renderArcGauge,
  renderSpeedometerGauge,
  renderRingDonutChart,
  renderInteractiveAreaChart,
  renderStackedBarChart,
  renderSparklineCard,
  mountLiveTelemetryStream,
  renderMatzDataTable,
  renderMatzCombobox,
  renderMatzOTPInput,
  renderMatzAccordion,
  renderMatzWaveformPlayer,
  openMatzDialog,
  openMatzSheetDrawer,
  openRaycastCommandModal,
  renderMatzNavigationRail,
  renderMatzChipsSuite,
  renderMatzStepperAndBreadcrumbs,
  renderMatzProgressAndIndicators,
  renderMatzAgenticUISuite,
  MatzApiClientModule,
  MatzEditorModule,
} from '@matz/ui';

// Vector Iconography (185+ icons across 10 categories with optical weight & variant control)
const iconHtml = matzIcon('bot', 20, '', {
  strokeWidth: 1.75, // 1.25 | 1.5 | 1.75 | 2 | 2.25
  variant: 'duotone', // 'outline' | 'duotone' | 'filled'
  ariaLabel: 'Assistente IA',
});

// Design System Navigation Rail, Chips, Stepper, Circular/Linear Progress & Agentic UI Suite
renderMatzNavigationRail(document.getElementById('nav-rail')!);
renderMatzChipsSuite(document.getElementById('chips')!);
renderMatzStepperAndBreadcrumbs(document.getElementById('stepper')!);
renderMatzProgressAndIndicators(document.getElementById('progress')!);
renderMatzAgenticUISuite(document.getElementById('agentic-ui')!);

// Radial 270° Arc Gauge (60fps in-place SVG updates, supports interactive slider)
const gauge = renderArcGauge(document.getElementById('gauge')!, {
  label: 'CPU Load',
  value: 74,
  max: 100,
  unit: '%',
  interactive: true,
});
gauge.setValue(82);

// Searchable Combobox
renderMatzCombobox(
  document.getElementById('combo')!,
  [
    { value: 'wails', label: 'Go 1.27 + Wails v3', badge: 'Native' },
    { value: 'vanilla', label: 'Vanilla TypeScript', badge: 'Default' },
  ],
  'vanilla',
  (selected) => showMatzToast(`Selected: ${selected}`)
);

// 6-Digit 2FA / TOTP Input
renderMatzOTPInput(document.getElementById('otp')!, 6, (code) => {
  showMatzToast(`Verified code: ${code}`);
});
```

## 5. Native Go + Wails Encapsulation Layer (`@matz/ui/wails`)

Use `createMatzWailsBridge` to encapsulate Wails v2/v3 desktop APIs with automatic browser fallback:

```ts
import { createMatzWailsBridge } from '@matz/ui/wails';

const wails = createMatzWailsBridge({
  windowControls: true,
  eventsIPC: true,
  serviceBinder: true,
  nativeDialogs: true,
});

await wails.window.setTitle('My App');
const res = await wails.call< { status: string } >('App.HealthCheck');
```

## 6. AI Generation Rules (Best Practices)

1. Default to **Vanilla TypeScript + Native CSS3** unless the user explicitly asks for React, Vue, or Svelte.
2. Always associate `<label for="id">` with form inputs (`id="id"`) and include `aria-label` on icon-only buttons.
3. Add `.matz-tabular` (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`) to any element displaying real-time numbers, percentages, or metrics to guarantee `CLS = 0`.
